title: Resolution to set a lower interest rate on delinquent tax plans
summary: This resolution sets the interest rate at 2.5% per year for Fiscal Year 2027 for property owners who have entered into installment payment agreements with the Department of Finance for delinquent taxes and other charges. This is lower than the 5% recommended by the Banking Commission. The Council notes that the number of delinquent properties has declined since Fiscal Year 2023, suggesting the current rate is effective.
